files.summary: separate delivered placement and falling mechanisms from remaining spatial acceptance and obsolete conversion work
edits: These are the spatial project’s scoped milestones, not the current whole-game build order. [Playable-game priorities](../repertoires/gameplay-priorities.md) control feature selection; reuse delivered geometry, movement and presentation rather than rebuilding them before enemies, exploration or rewards. The still-open correctness and qualification requirements below retain their owners.

placement: exposed roots carry XYZ and support in their world placement, while contained/attached items carry a parent reference, not a second independent position. Heading/body-profile state remains separate; no renderer or altitude-only writer may compete with the placement own

Current-format worlds validate through the startup/load owner; incompatible development saves are rejected under the [root policy](../../AGENTS.md#development-save-policy), not migrated or reset. Do not introduce feature-specific save versions, optional-Y world placements or permanent dual formats. Contained/attached items intentionally have no independent XYZ

Extend the delivered finite flyer fall/landing path to broader ground/support loss, swept collision and body-effect integration; do not rebuild its saved falling velocity and support acquisition. Define action interruption, retained resource/item ownership and impact consequences. Reconcile the existing hard-coded acceleration, terminal speed and −16-metre unsupported-world guard with world-owned rules and supported geometry ([LA152](../limits/spatial.md#la152)); a finite fallback is not a general falling model
historical SQLite route restoration checks do not satisfy that full matrix. New database checks use PostgreSQL only; historical adapter results are not a parity requirement

Use the current-format startup/load and placement owners, not a fresh-directory cutover, old-save conversion or automatic reset; the [development compatibility policy](../../AGENTS.md#development-save-policy) controls later work
